This is a symptom, and it is one for a doctor, not a coach. Coughing up blood needs to be seen by a medical professional promptly, so please contact a doctor or urgent care now, and if it is heavy or you are short of breath, call emergency services. I'm not able to tell you what it means or whether it's anything to worry about.

Once a doctor or physio has cleared you, I'll train around whatever they say. Until then, we're holding off on sprints. When you're ready to talk training again, tell me what they told you.
